activity_summary: At her table the penny loaf was two fingers short of the notch. The meal was threepence, on the slate, and you did not pay the weekly sixpence again. Alse asked whether Saturday was the lovers, and whether there was a moon in it. Mistress Ansell did not agree to anyone going. You went back to play Egeon.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Ate, named the threepence and the sixpence as different sums, and promised nothing about Saturday.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Measured the loaf, put threepence on the slate, and shut the talk of going.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Asked after Saturday and after a moon, and was told the second was not a promise.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Said the baker's loaf was light as well, and said when he would be at the loom.

facets.activity: Ate the short loaf at her table

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Threepence on the slate for the broth and the short loaf.
